title: Restriction along a coefficient isomorphism intertwines canonical tensor pullback
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, let $R$ and $S$ be sheaves of commutative rings on their small pro-etale sites, and let $c:f^{-1}R\cong S$ be an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $U:D(S)\to D(f^{-1}R)$ for exact derived restriction along $c$ [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Let $L_c$ and $L_i$ be geometric pullback with coefficients $c$ and the identity of the literal inverse-image ring. Let $b:L_c;U\cong L_i$ be the canonical restriction/pullback comparison, with identity scalar restriction on the base removed by the canonical exact-derived identity comparison. Fix signed-total flat K-flat tensor models $a_Y,z,a_X$ for $R,f^{-1}R,S$ respectively [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], with canonical geometric tensor comparisons $\alpha_i,\alpha_c$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. There exists a natural isomorphism $\rho:z(U(-),U(-))\cong U(a_X(-,-))$ such that for all $F,G\in D(R)$,
$$b_{a_Y(F,G)};\alpha_i(F,G)=U(\alpha_c(F,G));\rho^{-1}_{L_cF,L_cG};z(b_F,b_G).$$
All derived categories are ordinary and unbounded. The statement concerns only tensor and inverse image; it neither contains a direct image nor asserts a projection formula.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R)
    (z : ProEtaleTensorModel X
      ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R))
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X S) :
    ∃ rho : ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom).prod (pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom)) ⋙ z.tensor ≅
        aX.tensor ⋙ pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom,
      ∀ F G : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y R),
        (pullback f R S c).hom.app (aY.tensor.obj (F, G)) ≫
          (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f R
            ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R)
            (Iso.refl _) aY z).hom.app (F, G) =
        (pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom).map
            ((proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f R S c aY aX).hom.app (F, G)) ≫
          rho.inv.app ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c).obj F,
            (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c).obj G) ≫
          z.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((pullback f R S c).hom.app F)
            ((pullback f R S c).hom.app G))
